title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: kdbtree
text:
k-d-B-tree
k-d-B-tree
(data structure)
Definition:
A data structure which splits multidimensional spaces like an
adaptive k-d tree
, but balances the resulting tree like a
B-tree
.
Note:
After
[GG98]
.
